difficulty_reason: For an open U of a scheme S and a surjective integral morphism V -> U, the lemma constructs a surjective integral morphism Vbar -> S with Vbar x_S U isomorphic to V. The retained proof is written: take V' -> S the normalization of S in U (Morphisms section on normalization; the author's phrase normalization of S in U refers to the relative normalization attached to the integral cover V over U), which is integral by construction; the two Morphisms lemmas normalization-localization and normalization-in-integral identify the inverse image of U in V' with V itself; adjoining the reduced boundary Z = (S \ U)_red, the coproduct Vbar = V' coproduct Z is integral and surjective over S and restricts to V over U. Retained author proof at lines 13693-13702.
